card.name: Digits inside section and decimal numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or periods inside numbers, such as the second part of a section number (2.2) or a digit in a decimal or table value. It fires in numbered section headings and in statistics tables.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The repeated digit after the dot in a numbered label heading such as 2.2 or 5.5.

modes.label: Decimal values
modes.description: A digit or period within a decimal figure in a results table or protocol step.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, such as a section number or a decimal in a results table.
